record.dic_text:
08027 shillesh {shil-le:sh'}

字根型, 可能原意為"增強", 就是"變成三倍"; TWOT - 2403; 動詞

欽定本 - three years old 3, third time 2, threefold 1, three 1,
     three parts 1, three days 1; 9

1) 做第三次, 分割成三部分
   1a) (Piel) 做第三次, 分割成三部分
   1b) (Pual) 三歲, 三倍
record.edic_text:
08027 shalash {shaw-lash'}

a primitive root perhaps originally to intensify, ie treble;
      TWOT - 2403; v

AV - three years old 3, third time 2, threefold 1, three 1,
     three parts 1, three days 1; 9

1) to do a third time, do three times, divide in three parts
   1a) (Piel) to do a third time, divide into three parts
   1b) (Pual) to be three years of age, be threefold
